name: Shoot
doc: Shoot (Wendigo's enemy attack; the act family): one emitter per action - the kick sound, the ball's prim models, an actor system (its actor data the exe's) and the ball: party slot 1 grabbed and morphed into a ball, passed between slots 0 and 2 with kick bursts (the exe's pass and kick scripts), shot away, landing with dust, given back and walking back; the damage. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag042_shoot.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its state functions called from the phases, its parts spawned by it): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own - and the exe data words pointing into it (the engine's global index, the word)

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

act.doc: The act family's master: once its children are gone, the actor pools carved from the arena top and cleared; the actor counters cleared every tick

pools.doc: the ball spawner, the ball, the bursts, the dust (the port's)
the ball's and the kicks' prim models (the port's)

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action: the kick sound, the ball's prim models, the actor system (its actor data the exe's), the ball spawner, the master's release, the damage

parts.title: Ball
parts.doc: Party slot 1 grabbed, morphed into a ball, passed between slots 0 and 2 (the exe's pass and kick scripts), shot away, landing with dust, walking back

groups.label: Sounds
groups.doc: The kick (at the emitter's sound tick), the landing

groups.label: Actor system
groups.doc: At the emitter's start: Start, Length (ticks), Mode

params.label: Sound tick
params.doc: The kick sound at this tick

params.label: Release tick
params.doc: The master may start the next action at this tick

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage of its targets from this tick

params.label: Grab ticks
params.doc: The morph starts at this tick of the ball

params.label: Morph
params.doc: Into the ball a tick (4096: all of it)

params.label: Passes tick
params.doc: Held until this tick, then the passes

params.label: Shot distance
params.doc: The shot lands this far along the entity's facing from its place

params.label: Gravity
params.doc: Added to its falling speed a tick

params.label: Unmorph
params.doc: Back from the ball a tick in the shot (4096: all of it)

tasks.doc: One per action: the module's own emitter (the port's task): the kick sound, the ball's prim models, the actor system and the ball spawner, the master's release, the damage.
